tools.verdict: Twenty is the strongest open-source bet for teams that want Salesforce-shaped CRM data on their own server and are willing to run a young codebase. The AI workspace features are real, but the project is three years old and the premium-feature split is still settling.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Self-hosted core is free under AGPLv3 with Pro features included; Cloud Pro is $9/user/mo billed yearly and Organization $19/user/mo, with premium features gated behind an Enterprise key (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Objects, workflows, email sync and dashboards cover the CRM baseline; workflow AI agents and AI-built dashboards push past it, though marketing campaign tooling is absent (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: Gmail, Outlook and CalDAV sync plus signed webhooks and REST/GraphQL APIs ship in core; there is no connector marketplace to extend beyond that (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: An AI chatbot over workspace data, agents inside workflows and a native MCP server on cloud workplaces put it ahead of most CRM peers (tools.json ai_features; MCP is a site claim).

openness.evidence: AGPLv3 with all Pro features in the free self-hosted tier and 56.5k GitHub stars; only premium add-ons need a paid key (tools.json, github.com/twentyhq/twenty).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2023 with 56.5k stars and fast shipping, but no decade of operational history and the enterprise support tier is still forming (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Frappe CRM is the pragmatic free CRM for teams already in the Frappe or ERPNext world. No AI features and a thin connector list keep it out of AI-heavy stacks.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free to self-host under AGPL-3.0 with unlimited users; Frappe Cloud hosting is $5/mo per site and dedicated servers $20 to $60/mo, all published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Leads, deals, tasks and views cover the CRM baseline cleanly, and ERPNext adjacency adds operations depth, but marketing automation sits outside the product (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: Five documented connectors (Twilio, Exotel, WhatsApp, ERPNext, Meta Lead Ads) and no public API flag in the catalog; the Frappe framework fills some gaps (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: No AI features are documented in the catalog as of 2026-09-28 (tools.json ai_features is empty).

openness.evidence: AGPL-3.0, self-hosted, 3.5k GitHub stars, unlimited users on the free tier (tools.json, github.com/frappe/frappe-crm).

operational_maturity.evidence: Built by Frappe with ERPNext's decade of operations behind it, though the CRM product itself is younger and has a smaller ecosystem (tools.json deep_dive).

tools.verdict: Monica is a personal CRM done honestly: relationships, reminders and notes, priced at one flat plan. It is not a sales pipeline tool, and it does not pretend to be.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Self-host free under AGPL; hosted is a single $9/mo or $90/yr plan with a 30-day trial and no card required, fully published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Contact timelines, reminders, notes and relationship tracking are deep for personal use, but there is no deal pipeline or campaign machinery (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: The catalog lists no named integrations; a public API exists for your own wiring (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: No AI features are documented in the catalog as of 2026-09-28 (tools.json ai_features is empty).

openness.evidence: AGPL self-hosting with 25.3k GitHub stars and the full feature set available free on your own server (tools.json, github.com/monicahq/monica).

operational_maturity.evidence: 25.3k stars and years of steady maintenance, but it runs as a small project without enterprise support machinery (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Profound is the enterprise pick for answer-engine visibility, with the widest engine coverage and demand data nobody else publishes. Pricing is a sales conversation, which is its own signal.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Quote-based with no published prices; the only public number is a free trial of 50 prompts daily for 7 days (tools.json, verified Sep 2026).

feature_depth.evidence: Visibility tracking across up to 9 engines, Prompt Volumes demand data, drafting agents and citations analytics make it a platform rather than a tracker (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Six documented connections including GA, Cloudflare and WordPress, plus an API; it stops short of a broad marketplace (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI Marketer agents that draft content and manage visibility work are core product, not add-ons (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise SaaS with no self-hosting or published data export guarantees in the catalog (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Sells to enterprise with the support model that implies, but the company is young and the catalog documents no founding year (tools.json).

tools.verdict: OtterlyAI is the buy for teams that want daily AI mention tracking without a procurement cycle: three published EUR tiers, clear prompt limits, and MCP access from the middle tier up.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Three published EUR tiers: Lite EUR 29/mo (15 prompts), Standard EUR 189/mo (100 prompts, API + MCP), Premium EUR 489/mo (400 prompts), all itemized (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Daily mention and citation tracking, prompt research, a visibility index and GEO audits cover the monitoring loop; it does not rewrite or publish content (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Tracks six named surfaces including ChatGPT, AI Overviews and Copilot, and ships Looker Studio and MCP connections from Standard up (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: The product measures AI answers rather than generating them; the GEO audit recommendations are its assistive layer (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS; API and MCP access from the Standard tier improve the data story but the platform itself is not open (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2024 and priced for teams, with the operational history still short (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Rankscale covers 17+ answer engines with retrieval diagnostics, which matters if your audience is not only on ChatGPT. Credit-based pricing is published but needs arithmetic before you buy.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Three published EUR tiers with credit pools (Pro EUR 99/mo for 1,200 credits up to Enterprise EUR 780/mo for 12,000), 15% annual saving and a 7-day trial (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Visibility, citation and sentiment across 17+ engines, query fan-out insights and page-level AI audits with readiness scoring (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: GA4, Search Console and Looker Studio connections plus REST API and MCP; no app marketplace beyond that (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Query fan-out retrieval insights and AI page audits with readiness scoring are genuinely model-aware features (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with API access; no self-hosting or open data portability terms documented (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Agency-facing with SSO and support tiers, but no founding year is documented and the company is young (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Trakkr's interesting angle is perception: how models describe your brand, not only whether they cite it. Per-brand pricing suits agencies running multiple workspaces.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Growth is $100/mo per brand (50 prompts, 8 models, 3 seats) or $1,000/yr annual, Scale $500/mo for 10 brands, both published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Citations, perception analysis, competitor rankings and action recommendations cover measurement and prioritization, stopping short of content execution (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Zapier, Slack, Sheets, Notion, HubSpot and WordPress are documented, which is a practical six for agency workflows (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Perception analysis of how AI describes your brand is the standout; the rest is model-output measurement (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS; no self-hosting or open export terms in the catalog (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Priced for brands and agencies with per-brand workspaces, but thin public company history (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Evertune buys depth of measurement: 100k prompts and 100 samples per model per prompt. At $800/mo entry it is for teams whose revenue actually depends on AI answers.

pricing_transparency.evidence: One published price (Pro $800/mo: 100,000 prompts, 11 models, 25 articles/mo) with the rest described but not itemized (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Prompt sampling at 100x per model, a 150M-prompt consumer panel, action agents and content activation make it measurement plus execution (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Five tracked AI surfaces are listed and no third-party app connections; the catalog marks no API (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: EverPanel's 150M real user prompts and the Insights and Action Agent are data and automation assets few competitors match (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with no API flag and no self-hosting story (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2024 with enterprise onboarding sessions in the plan; the operational history is short (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Nimt.ai prices like a utility and acts like a team: credits you can predict and an agent that writes and fixes. The card-required trial is the only friction in an otherwise clean offer.

pricing_transparency.evidence: EUR 40 free credits to start (card required), then Flex at EUR 79/mo for 10,000 credits with 72 prompts tracked daily, metering documented (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Daily tracking across 8 models, citation and fan-out analysis, and an agent that writes content, fixes pages and does outreach (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Slack, MCP, Search Console, HubSpot, WordPress and GA cover the working stack (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: The AI Search Agent writes content, fixes pages and outreaches; this is execution autonomy, not just analytics (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS, though MCP and an API-level credit system keep the data portable (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Young product with no founding year in the catalog and a card-required trial gate (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Adobe LLM Optimizer is for shops already inside Experience Cloud: CDN-edge fixes and revenue attribution nobody standalone offers. Outside that stack, the quote-only pricing makes it untestable.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Quote-based within Adobe Experience Cloud with no public numbers as of Sep 2026 (tools.json).

feature_depth.evidence: Share-of-voice across ten LLM families, ~300M enriched AI search prompts and CDN-edge content optimization served to crawlers (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Native ties to Adobe Analytics, CJA and AEM plus three CDN providers make it deep inside its own stack and narrow outside it (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: CDN-edge optimizations served to AI crawlers and clickstream-enriched prompt data are capabilities no standalone tracker has (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise product tied to an Adobe contract; the catalog documents no API (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2025 but built by Adobe inside Experience Cloud, inheriting its enterprise support and compliance machinery (tools.json).

tools.verdict: OpenOutreach is the rare lead tool you can read before you run: GPL, self-hosted, and its qualification reasoning is written down per lead. Budget for your own LLM keys and BetterContact credits.

pricing_transparency.evidence: The software is free (GPLv3) and the run costs are stated plainly: your own LLM keys and mailbox plus BetterContact credits at one credit per verified email (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: LLM keyword generation, per-lead qualification with written reasons and Gaussian Process learning over verdicts make a focused outbound tool, not a suite (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: BetterContact, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, SMTP/IMAP, Google Workspace and Instantly CSV export are documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: LLM qualification with a written reason per lead and model learning over your verdicts is agentic in the honest sense (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: GPLv3, self-hosted, 3.0k GitHub stars, and you bring your own keys so no usage is locked to a vendor (tools.json, github.com/...).

operational_maturity.evidence: A 3.0k-star self-hosted project with no company behind it; operations are yours (tools.json).

tools.verdict: The builder is free and MIT-licensed, which is the right way to sell a component. The hosted AI features land at $250/mo and up, so the real cost is where you draw the line.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free builder tier, then Launch $250/mo, Scale $750/mo, Optimize $2,000/mo published with 10% annual saving and 14-day trials (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Drag-and-drop editing across four frameworks plus template import covers the component job; the AI editing and generation layers sit on the paid plans (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: React, Angular, Vue and vanilla JS embeds, a Cloud API and OpenAI and Anthropic connections are documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI chat editing, image generation, template import and an Unlayer MCP server with Agent Skills for coding agents (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: MIT-licensed core with 5.2k GitHub stars; the hosted AI services are what you pay for (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: A commercial component vendor with priced tiers and trials behind the OSS core (tools.json).

tools.verdict: EspoCRM is the lightweight AGPL CRM with a real extension economy. The add-on prices are unpublished, so the free core is the only number you can plan around.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free self-hosted core under AGPLv3 is fully clear; the Advanced Pack and Intelligence add-ons exist but their prices are not listed (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Sales, marketing and customer management with workflow add-ons make a complete small-team CRM; BPM depth lives in the paid Advanced Pack (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: No named integrations in the catalog; a documented API carries the connection story (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: The Intelligence add-on exists but no AI features are itemized in the catalog as of 2026-09-28 (tools.json).

openness.evidence: AGPLv3 self-hosted since 2011 with 3.3k GitHub stars and the full core free (tools.json, github.com/espocrm).

operational_maturity.evidence: Shipping since 2011 with paid extension support; a long track record for a project this size (tools.json).

tools.verdict: SuiteCRM is the safe long-liver of open-source CRM: sales, marketing and support automation on one AGPL codebase. The AI era has not really arrived on it yet.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free self-hosted open source with paid cloud hosting available; the hosting prices are not itemized in the catalog (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Sales, marketing and support automation across one codebase covers the full CRM triangle, the reason it persists (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: No named integrations in the catalog; APIs and community modules carry the extension story (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: No AI features are documented in the catalog as of 2026-09-28 (tools.json ai_features is empty).

openness.evidence: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted with 5.7k GitHub stars and the whole suite free (tools.json, github.com/salesagility/SuiteCRM).

operational_maturity.evidence: A SugarCRM fork with years of production deployments and a stable release cadence (tools.json deep_dive).

tools.verdict: Krayin is the Laravel CRM for teams that want to own the code and extend it in PHP. MIT licensing is unusually permissive here; the paid multi-tenant SaaS module is the one visible upsell.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free to self-host under MIT with no user limits is perfectly clear; Webkul's extension prices are mostly unlisted beyond the $1,799 multi-tenant module (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Full customer lifecycle management with automation packages (triggers, conditions, actions) covers SME CRM needs; campaign machinery is thin (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: No named integrations in the catalog; Laravel and Webkul extensions carry the connection story (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Magic AI lead creation from uploaded PDFs and images via an OpenRouter module is real but narrow (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: MIT-licensed with 23.9k GitHub stars and no user limits on self-hosting (tools.json, github.com/krayin).

operational_maturity.evidence: Backed by Webkul's extension business with 23.9k stars, giving it more runway than a solo project (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Zapier remains the safest automation buy: the widest app catalog and the least surprising product. You pay per task for that safety, which scales into real money at volume.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free (100 tasks/mo, 2-step Zaps), Professional $19.99/mo and Team $69/mo billed annually, all published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Multi-step Zaps, logic, tables and the AI workflow builder cover nearly every automation shape a marketing team needs (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: 9,000+ connected apps including Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Zendesk and NetSuite; nothing else in the category is close on breadth (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI workflow builder, data formatting, content generation, chatbot builder and AI agents are all shipping product (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with a strong API; your workflows are portable only as re-builds (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2011 with the category's longest enterprise track record and status transparency (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Make buys more automation per dollar than Zapier and shows you the wiring while it runs. The credit meter rewards careful builders and punishes careless ones.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free (1,000 credits/mo), Core $9/mo, Pro $16/mo, Teams $29/mo each for 10,000 credits with a slider to 8M+, all published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Visual scenario building with routers, iterators and error handling plus AI agents covers complex branching automation well (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: The catalog's integration list was cleared as unverifiable (Cloudflare-walled directory); the app ecosystem is known to be large but we do not publish a count we cannot check (tools.json, see corrections).

ai_capability.evidence: AI agents, workflow suggestions, data transformation, content generation and error handling are documented product (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with a public API; scenarios are yours only as exports (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2012 and now inside Celonis, with the operational weight that implies (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Pipedream is the developer's automation host: code steps first, connectors second. Teams that live in code get more done here than anywhere else; everyone else will fight it.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free (100 credits/mo), Basic $29/mo (2,000 credits, 20M AI tokens), Advanced $49/mo, Connect $99/mo published, Business custom (tools.json, verified Sep 2026).

feature_depth.evidence: Data-driven triggers and HTTP steps with real code execution cover the programmable automation surface; the no-code layer is thinner than Make's (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: 2,500+ integrations advertised around a code-first component model (tools.json tagline).

ai_capability.evidence: AI tokens are priced into the plans and code steps can call any model, but there is no documented AI product layer in the catalog (tools.json).

openness.evidence: Closed platform, though code steps are plain Node or Python you can lift out (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: A known developer platform with usage-based plans and years in market (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Workato is the governance-first iPaaS: agent roles, audit machinery and enterprise editions. The pricing model is deliberately a conversation, and so is everything else.

pricing_transparency.evidence: No published prices: a platform edition fee plus a usage fee in one billing unit across four editions (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: AIRO multi-agent system, Agent Studio, role-based Genies and an Acumen data scientist agent sit on mature integration plumbing (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Slack, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Snowflake and HubSpot named in the catalog, with hundreds more behind the sales wall (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: A multi-agent system with role-based agents and agent studio is one of the deepest AI governance plays in the category (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise SaaS with contractual portability only (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2013 with enterprise editions and the support machinery regulated buyers require (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Tray.io sits between Pipedream and Workato: a builder's iPaaS with an agent gateway that takes MCP seriously. Task-metered pricing is published in shape but not in numbers.

pricing_transparency.evidence: No published prices: three tiers metered in Tasks with workspaces and log retention as the levers (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Merlin Agent Builder, an Agent Gateway for MCP, AI Palette and VectorTables make a current platform rather than a connector host (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Slack, HubSpot, Snowflake, Zendesk, BigQuery, Sheets, NetSuite plus OpenAI and Claude connections documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Merlin Agent Builder and the MCP Agent Gateway put agents at the center of the platform, not the edge (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise SaaS; portability is contractual (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2012 with enterprise tiers and mature support posture (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Scrunch's Agent Pages are the differentiator: it serves your content to AI crawlers in a form they can digest. The monitoring is competent; the serving layer is why you would pick it.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Core is $250/mo (125 prompts, 5 audits, 4 LLMs, 5 users) with published limits; Enterprise is custom (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Citation tracking across 4 to 9 LLMs, Agent Pages serving token-optimized content and agent-facing site diagnostics (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Looker Studio, MCP, a Query API and a CLI cover programmatic access without an app marketplace (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Agent Pages that serve token-optimized content to AI agents is infrastructure work aimed at how models actually read (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS but with MCP, a Query API and a CLI keeping your data reachable (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2023 with enterprise SSO on the roadmap tiers; short history (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Promptfoo is the one in this category you can run tonight and read end to end: MIT evals and red teaming with 25k stars. The cloud tiers price quietly, which does not matter much when the core is free.

pricing_transparency.evidence: The open-source CLI is free and clear; cloud and enterprise tiers exist on promptfoo.dev with no public numbers extracted (tools.json, verified Sep 2026).

feature_depth.evidence: Model-graded evals, automated red team probe generation and multi-provider prompt runs make a real test bench (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock and GitHub Actions cover the evaluation pipeline (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: One LLM grading another's answers plus automated red team probe generation are meta-AI capabilities with real teeth (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: MIT-licensed with 25.5k GitHub stars and a CLI-first design you can run anywhere (tools.json, github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo).

operational_maturity.evidence: 25.5k stars plus a commercial entity behind the cloud tiers give it both community and runway (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Ahrefs is the established SEO stack that bolted AI visibility on properly: Brand Radar reads like a product, not a checkbox. Pricing is published per tier, which suits buying committees.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Lite $129/mo, Standard $249/mo, Advanced $449/mo published with add-ons itemized from $99/mo; only Enterprise is quoted (tools.json, verified Sep 2026).

feature_depth.evidence: A decade of backlink and keyword depth with Brand Radar's AI share of voice and estimated impressions layered on top (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Search Console, Looker Studio, the Ahrefs API and an SEO MCP server cover the working connections (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Brand Radar tracks mentions and citations across AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with an API and MCP server; the data business is the product (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: One of the longest-running SEO data vendors with published tiers and a public roadmap (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Ortto bundles CDP and marketing automation at a mid-market price, with AI sprinkled where it saves time. The 12-month commitment on larger plans is the term to negotiate first.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Starter from $199/mo with a 14-day trial is published; larger plans require a 12-month commitment and email overage is $1 per 1,000 (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Journeys, a CDP layer and analytics in one platform cover the marketing automation loop end to end (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: Twelve named connectors including Salesforce, Shopify, Stripe, Segment and Zendesk plus API access (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI subject lines, content suggestions, natural-language segment filters and enrichment are helpful utilities rather than agents (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with API access; data leaves via export (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2015 with priced tiers and trials; a known mid-market option (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Marketing Cloud Next is the enterprise decision made twice: once for the Agentforce automation and once for the decade of lock-in behind it. The published per-org pricing is unusually honest for this tier.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Per-org list pricing is published: Growth $1,500/mo and Advanced $3,250/mo billed annually, Starter $25/user/mo, personalization add-ons itemized (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Campaign creation, personalization decisioning, paid media optimization and cross-channel execution on Data 360 plumbing (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce CRM, Data 360, Slack, Tableau, MuleSoft, Snowflake, Shopify, Google and Meta Ads documented in the catalog (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Agentforce runs campaign creation, personalization decisioning and paid media optimization as agents, not features (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise suite; exit is a migration program (tools.json deep_dive).

operational_maturity.evidence: Salesforce backing with per-org pricing, named editions and the compliance machinery regulated buyers expect (tools.json).
